title: An Ability Label Raises the Effort of an Agent (MRF-2026-03 reproducibility data)
description: Reproducibility data for Montana Research Foundation preprint MRF-2026-03, "An Ability Label Raises the Effort of an Agent": per-rollout aggregate records and a self-contained verify.py that recomputes the paper's headline from the records alone. Task families, raw agent transcripts, and held-out grading data are withheld under contamination control.
